dedupe_keys.name: metrolinx open data go transit and up express ontario

description: Metrolinx, the Ontario provincial agency that runs GO Transit and UP Express in the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area, publishes open datasets under the province's Digital and Data Directive. They include General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) schedules for GO Transit and UP Express, a shapefile of the Frequent Rapid Transit Network, GO rail parking and utilisation data and an archived fiscal year-to-date ridership report. A data inventory lists all of the agency's datasets and marks whether each is open, under review or exempt for legal, privacy, security, confidentiality or commercial reasons, and the GO API gives programmatic access to GO information after creating an account. Public engineering references on Metrolinx projects are also offered. Coverage is regional. The data are free under the Open Government Licence – Ontario – Metrolinx. Caveats: the open set is small compared with the full inventory, the ridership report is archived, and API access needs registration. The data support regional rail and bus network models, station parking capacity planning and accessibility studies. They complement the GTFS specification and the Mobility Database catalogued here.
